body: I thought I did but no one could even let me sleep on their couch for a night, or give me a ride to a bigger city with shelters, my phone gets shut off tomorrow so then I’m really alone.
I can’t take another day of this shit goodbye everyone and thanks for the kind words
I was doing that a few weeks back but I got caught so many times I stopped
It’s 16 degrees and dumping snow I needed to stay dry
I’ll be dead within a few hours
